opus.problem: The cited verse (Genesis 28:18) does not name the place. Jacob naming it Bethel is in Genesis 28:19, so the reference does not support the clue pointing to this word.
Two bears mauling forty-two boys is not in the cited verse (2 Kings 2:23). It is in 2 Kings 2:24, so the clue is not true to its given verse.

Amaziah, his being a priest of Bethel, and his telling Amos to flee to Judah are not in the cited verse (Amos 7:13). They come from Amos 7:10-12. Amos 7:13 only says never to prophesy at Bethel again.
Burning bones from nearby tombs on the altar is not in the cited verse (2 Kings 23:15). It is in 2 Kings 23:16. Verse 15 describes burning the high place and the Asherah pole.
The ark of the covenant being there is not in the cited verse (Judges 20:26). It is in Judges 20:27.
